title: Chapter 2777 - 112: The Great Witch’s Skill
content:
Chapter 2777: Chapter 112: The Great Witch’s Skill

Within the yellow-white Bone Book Order, there was a moment of silence.

Evidently, the "Great Witch’s Curse Killing Technique" mentioned by Iron Skill Bone was no ordinary spell point.

Not only was Iron Skill Bone fearful of this, but even Lord Lugu was extremely wary.

Lugu pondered for a long time and finally replied:

"This matter is not urgent; we need to deliberate thoroughly."

But how could Iron Skill Bone not be anxious?

"Lord Lugu, you simply don’t understand!"

Iron Skill Bone’s expression was anxious, concealing terror, "I serve the Demon with my body, and accompany this Demon Monster, knowing more than anyone how frighteningly his power improves, even though his realm seems unchanged and his appearance is calm."

"Previously, it was only a matter of Divine Thought, but now the oppressive force is increasingly profound."

"Recently, for some reason, this Demon Monster gives me the feeling as if it’s undergoing an even deeper ’transformation’ internally..."

"The Telekinesis is seemingly the same as before, yet the whole body exudes a ’ferocity’ that can devour everything, like an unparalleled fierce demon..."

"I even suspect that it won’t be long before his Demon Monster nature ’manifests’."

...

Behind Iron Skill Bone, Mo Hua’s expression was somewhat peculiar.

I’ve already been very "restrained."

The Divine Thought is contained within myself, and the "Taotie’s" Law is also confined to the Sea of Consciousness.

This Iron Skill Bone can actually still detect my "strength"?

Is it due to Iron Skill Bone’s preconceived notions and prejudice against me being a Demon Monster, leading him to perceive and speculate like this?

Or is his faith too deep, making him particularly "sensitive" to matters of the Divine Way?

Mo Hua fell into contemplation.

Iron Skill Bone continued to desperately persuade Lugu to kill Mo Hua:

"Therefore, we must not delay; if you want to kill, you must do it early. Delays will surely bring disaster!"

Lugu only said: "The Great Witch’s technique cannot be used lightly."

Iron Skill Bone said: "The cunning and insidious nature of this Demon Monster is truly unpredictable; without the Great Witch’s technique, he cannot be killed."

Lugu said: "You should understand that such Great Witch techniques have long been lost, only some Shugu ancients who broke the ’taboo’ in the past learned it."

"And those ancients are long dead."

"To awaken them and ask them to use the Great Witch’s technique to curse this Demon Monster to death would require a tremendous price."

Iron Skill Bone said with a devout expression, "I, Iron Skill Bone, am willing to pay any price to eradicate this demon, even my life."

Lugu’s gaze was stern as he replied with blood-written words:

"Awakening the dead ancients to kill the living—even if this person is a Demon Monster—violates twofold ’life and death’ taboos."

"Breaking such a taboo, do you think the price is just one life of yours?"

"If something goes wrong in the process..."

Lugu’s gaze was terrifying as he spoke word by word:

"The dead unwilling to die again, the living stripped of their ’life’ essence—this would lead to... a disastrous catastrophe for the tribe; can you, Iron Skill Bone, bear it?"

Iron Skill Bone was silent.

His intent to kill was too heavy, naturally leading to a lack of comprehensive consideration.

But his killing intent was not out of selfishness, but out of loyalty to the tribe, especially his faith in the Barbarian God.

Iron Skill Bone had a strong premonition:

"If the ancients aren’t awakened to kill this Demon Monster, then this Demon Monster would be the ’great disaster’ for my Shugu Tribe."

Lugu also frowned deeply.

After pondering for a moment, Lugu slowly communicated through writing: "This matter should be deliberated at length. Before that, let’s try other methods."

"What method?"

Lugu said: "I have agreed to ally with this Demon Monster and return to the Third Grade Vermilion Bird Realm. Once in the Third Grade Mountain Realm, with my Late Golden Core Stage cultivation, I can find an opportunity to destroy his physical body and obliterate his foundation."

Iron Skill Bone retorted: "It’s a Demon Monster; if you destroy its physical body, can it die?"

"It can die..." Mo Hua nodded silently in his heart.

His Divine Thought is strong, but his physical body is very weak; wouldn’t he die if killed?

Unfortunately, Iron Skill Bone couldn’t hear this.

Lugu wasn’t certain either and said: "Once the physical body is destroyed, even if it doesn’t die, it would certainly suffer great injuries to its Vital Energy, and its Demon Monster true nature would be exposed under broad daylight, subject to scorn, and its sacred Shaman guise torn off, making it hard to deceive people and stir troubles."

Mo Hua nodded inwardly.

What Lugu said actually made a lot of sense.

The unfortunate part is that I’m really not a Demon Monster, nor am I afraid of broad daylight.

Iron Skill Bone sighed and could only say: "Fine."

He was at the Initial Golden Core stage, a commander of a Wandering Tribe, unable to override Lugu, the late-stage Golden Core Main General of Shugu.

Furthermore, awakening the dead Shugu ancients to ask them to curse-kill Mo Hua is not something he can accomplish alone.

Lastly, Lugu inquired about the matters of the ’Bone Heavy Armor’ forging method that concerned him most.

Iron Skill Bone only said: "This is the absolute secret of that Demon Monster, never told to anyone, and the valley where the armor is forged is a forbidden land, not allowing anyone to step foot, impossible to spy on."

Lugu did not ask further.

This deep night "private chat" ended here.

Iron Skill Bone continued his night study by candlelight, tirelessly flipping through the classic texts of Shugu and other tribes, seeking ways to completely annihilate the "Demon Monster" Mo Hua walking under daylight.

Mo Hua appreciated his diligence and did not disturb his "efforts," quietly leaving.

...

After leaving, Mo Hua returned to his room, sat by the table, and fell into deep thought.

"The Great Witch’s technique..."

"This technique, said to be able to ’curse to death’, what kind of spell point is it really..."

"Curse... is it related to karma?"

"Great Witch... could it be associated with... the Great Shaman?"

Mo Hua’s gaze was somewhat solemn.

But this was not the most important.
